# DiagramCloud sidecar fixtures

Generated by DiagramCloud itself (`julian-passebecq/diagramcloud`, `src/bridge/sidecar.ts` `serializeSidecar`), not hand-written:

- `total.sidecar.json`: the public TotalEnergies portfolio sample exactly as DiagramCloud writes `.datapass/diagramcloud.json`.
- `total.after-plan.sidecar.json`: DiagramCloud's re-serialization of DataPass's output after applying `set-project-metadata` (title "Renamed by plan", summary "New summary") and `link-node-workspace` (powerbi → controls-screen). DataPass must produce these exact bytes, so a DiagramCloud save after a DataPass apply produces no Git diff.

Regenerated on 2026-09-25 from DiagramCloud `main` at `43f3d953454485b9d0cfd05dd7d43882f7ea7028`
(PR #6 merged; `src/bridge/sidecar.ts` blob `0b561255`, `src/core/model.ts` blob `cc7677be`). That version
adds defaulted fields (`milestones`, workspace `accent` and `context`), so the earlier fixtures from the PR #11
branch no longer matched DiagramCloud's own output. The round trip was re-checked against that `main`:
DataPass's write equals DiagramCloud's re-serialization byte for byte. A sidecar last saved by an older
DiagramCloud gains those defaults once, on its next DiagramCloud save; that diff is DiagramCloud's migration,
not DataPass churn.

Portfolio sample content is synthetic/source-derived teaching material, not verified employer results.
